relationships.escaped-prisoners-015-group: Hijackers who choose the worst possible flight because Amane is aboard.

periods.summary: Amane boards a flight while heading to participate in special conscription. Six escaped prisoners attempt a hijacking, but the aircraft suffers a catastrophic engine and wing failure that nonetheless ends in an impossibly safe landing because Amane's luck makes the plane avoid casualties. He reveals himself as Bad Luck and incapacitates prisoner 015 with his rapier Device, treating the encounter as both lucky and unlucky.

key_events.summary: His causality luck turns a hijacking into a failed emergency landing with no fatalities.
